title: Bossk
franchise: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
description: Bossk, a reptilian Trandoshan, was one of the most feared bounty hunters in the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, he partnered with Aurra Sing, Castas, and a very young Boba Fett, but ended up in prison. He made his way through the dark times and answered Darth Vader's call when Vader sought bounty hunters to capture the Millennium Falcon during the Galactic Civil War.
